title: Tax Audit Applicability for FY 2026-27: Thresholds, Forms & CA Certification
summary: Demystifying turnover caps under Section 44AB, cash transaction ratios, Form 3CA-3CD compliance, and tax audit due date extension news.
body:
Section 44AB mandates statutory tax audits for businesses exceeding ₹1 Crore turnover (raised to ₹10 Crores if cash transactions remain below 5%). For professionals, the threshold remains ₹50 Lakhs (or ₹75 Lakhs under 44ADA).

Key Scrutiny Focal Points in Form 3CD:
- Clause 13: Method of accounting and inventory valuation.
- Clause 21(a): Personal expenditure disallowance.
- Clause 26: Statutory liability remittances covered under Section 43B.
- Clause 34: Compliance with withholding tax (TDS/TCS) directives.

Ensure books of accounts are finalized before the CA audit deadline to avoid penalties under Section 271B. To schedule an audit review for your business in Hooghly or Kolkata, visit our [Appointment Booking Desk](/schedule).
